findings.title: Removed option 'grouping.experiments.parameterization.traceparent' may break usages still referencing it
findings.body: The traceparent parameterization experiment option registration was removed, but it's unclear if any code paths still reference this option key via options.get(). If so, this would raise an UnknownOption error or silently fail. Given parameterization.py's traceparent regex is still part of DEFAULT_PARAMETERIZATION_REGEXES, verify no remaining references to this option exist before removing its registration.

findings.title: Removed ParameterizationRegexExperiment and related dead branch without replacement
findings.body: ParameterizationRegexExperiment class and the isinstance-based branching in parametrize_w_experiments were removed, along with the exported name in __all__. This removes support for pure-regex experiments distinct from callable experiments. If any external/future code relied on this type (e.g. the removed traceparent experiment option), it is now unsupported. This is a breaking API change for the parameterization module with no reported deprecation path.

findings.title: get_environment_info can throw during logging if issue.id used inside except with partial failure
findings.body: In get_environment_info, if get_recommended_event() or get_environment() raises, the exception is caught generically and logged, but if issue.id itself is unavailable (unlikely) or the exception message `e` is not serializable this could cause secondary issues. More importantly, catching bare Exception here silently swallows errors (including potential programming errors) without re-raising, which could mask real bugs when environment data fails to be retrieved for valid reasons unrelated to missing environment info.

findings.title: Visualize no longer supports multiple yAxes per overlay; breaking change condensing feature
findings.body: The Visualize class and UI were changed from supporting multiple yAxes per visualize (chart) to a single yAxis. This removes the ability to overlay multiple series within one chart entry, changing established UX/API behavior (toolbarVisualize.tsx, visualizes.tsx). Any saved queries, URLs, or state relying on multiple yAxes per Visualize may lose data fidelity, since Visualize.fromJSON now expands multiple yAxes into multiple separate Visualize instances instead of preserving them as one grouped chart. This is a significant behavior change but doesn't appear well guarded with migration logic for existing saved searches containing multi-yAxis visualizes beyond simple fan-out, potentially altering labels/semantics for users with existing saved queries.

findings.title: updateLocationWithAggregateFields flattens visualizes, which changes semantic grouping and label assignment
findings.body: The change from mapping each aggregateField to one yAxes-based BaseVisualize to flatMapping multiple Visualize instances from Visualize.fromJSON means grouped overlays (previously one Visualize with multiple yAxes) are now split into multiple separate serialized entries. This can alter chart label numbering/order (`label: String.fromCharCode(65+i)`) when round-tripping through location state, inconsistent with the previous grouped behavior, and could break saved query comparisons that expect one BaseVisualize per original grouping.

findings.title: Added noise_config without accompanying tests
findings.body: A new noise_config = NoiseConfig(ignore_limit=5) was added to DBQueryInjectionVulnerabilityGroupType, but there's no test coverage verifying this new noise suppression behavior takes effect for this specific group type, risking silent misconfiguration if ignore_limit semantics change.
